content:
Mica: Heads up — we just got an inbound from Acme Logistics: manifest 7F-PLT-882 looks like it has wrong rack labels. This affects two Dedicated reservations (resv-83321, resv-83322) that were supposed to be on EU-D1 racks.
Jordan_ops: Noted. Is this a labeling swap or missing units? Can you paste the manifest snippet?
Mica: It looks like a swap. From the carrier: ```MANIFEST 7F-PLT-882
SKU: RACK-EU-D1-08 qty:4
SKU: RACK-EU-D2-16 qty:4
LABELS: swapped between pallets 3 and 5
``` 
Sophie_CS: Oh no — those 4 D1 racks are committed to a mid-market customer with SLA on 3/25. If we can't deliver D1, we need a substitute or credit.
Leo_sales: @Sophie_CS which customer? we may have spare D1 in another PO (PO-9921) but it's in transit to FRA, ETA +4 days.
Mica: Customer is BloomByte - committed on Dedicated monthly. They were told dedicated capacity by 3/24.
Amal_partner: Hi team, Acme support here. We're pulling photos and will confirm chain-of-custody within 30m. Preliminary: label printer at the depot had a buffer overrun; looks like a batch misassign during consolidation.
AcmeLogisticsBot: [auto] Incident created: ACME-INC-4422 — label mismatch reported for manifest 7F-PLT-882. ETA for corrective handling: 12-48h depending on depot throughput.
Jordan_ops: If remediation takes >24h we should request a temporary reroute to FRA depot holding PO-9921 and swap inventory on the carrier leg. Can ops raise an exception for cross-dock swap?
Mica: I'll open cross-dock request with logistics now. @Amal_partner can Acme prioritize this as expedited? customer SLA risk.
Amal_partner: Yes, we can escalate to expedited handling and request carrier reroute, but there may be a fee. I'll ask for waiving fees given it's our label error.
Sophie_CS: Also need a customer comms draft. Short message: "minor logistics update — no impact to service" only if we can confirm substitution same day. Otherwise, must offer a credit. @Leo_sales prepare pricing impact.
Leo_sales: If we must credit 1 week of Dedicated for BloomByte that's ~£6.2k — need finance ok. I'll model two scenarios: same-day swap (no credit) vs >3d delay (credit + 10% SLA credit). Running numbers.
Jordan_ops: For rollout safety, enable automatic fallback to model variant with EU-D2 capability mapped to lower throughput for that route so hosted traffic isn't impacted. Ops tag: route eu-dedicated -> eu-d2-fallback.
Mica: Good call. I'll add a temporary routing policy in the console. Also flag Redwood Console alerts for token-level latency on BloomByte routes.
Amal_partner: Update: depot confirms 2 swapped pallets on the truck that can be relabeled on-site, will be fixed in ~2h if carrier holds. Otherwise cross-dock swap required.
Sophie_CS: Great. If it's 2h relabel we can avoid customer notice. @Taylor_sales can you stand by for comms approval? quick thumbs up only.
Taylor_sales: Thumbs up. If Acme confirms relabel in <3h, we'll send: "Thanks — issue resolved, no customer impact." Otherwise send the contingency note with credit offer.
Mica: Action items: 1) Amal to confirm relabel timeframe (due +2h). 2) Jordan to prepare routing fallback (done by +30m). 3) Leo to model credit scenarios (+1h). 4) Sophie draft two comms templates (+45m). 5) Mica to coordinate cross-dock if needed. I'll update thread when Acme confirms.
Amal_partner: On it — filing depot ticket 7F-DEP-201, will ping here when relabel confirmed. :raised_hands:
Mica: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as single source.
